mapper.select: SELECT config_id, config_name, config_code, config_value, config_type, description, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM finance_config WHERE config_id = #{configId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_config ( config_id, config_name, config_code, config_value, config_type, description, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{config.configId}, #{config.configName}, #{config.configCode}, #{config.configValue}, #{config.configType}, #{config.description}, #{config.status}, #{config.createBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_config SET config_name = #{config.configName}, config_code = #{config.configCode}, config_value = #{config.configValue}, config_type = #{config.configType}, description = #{config.description}, status = #{config.status}, update_by = #{config.updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE config_id = #{config.configId}
